Ɣr tasertit n tbaḍnit n WeatherChum
Aleqqem aneggaru: 28 Yulyu 2026
Tasertit n tbaḍnit

Asnas-agi (\"Asnas\") ismal-ak-d talɣut n aksum tamirant akked tugniwin n aksum yemsasan s wanect n wemkan-ik, yezmer ad iseqdec tugna i textareḍ neɣ i tṭṭfeḍ akken ad d-yesnulfu agilal n aksum ittwaselken ɣur-k. Nettwali s lqima tabaḍnit-ik. Sedday-ak ad teɣreḍ akken iwata anwa isefka i nesseqdac, acuɣer, akked melmi ara ten-neṭṭef.
1. D acu n isefka i nesseqdac?

• Isefka n wemkan (GPS): akken ad k-d-nessken talɣut n aksum akked tugniwin n agilal yemsasan i temnaḍt-ik, nesseqdac amkan-ik. Imukan-ik ineggura yettwaseqdacen ttwaṭṭfen deg wallag-ik s yiman-is, akken Asnas ad yizmir ad d-yesken aksum iwatan s tazwara akken ara yebdu.

• Tugniwin i textareḍ neɣ i tṭṭfeḍ: ma yella tṭṭfeḍ tugna neɣ textareḍ yiwet seg wallag-ik n tugniwin akken ad tesseqdaceḍ am agilal n aksum udmawan, tugna-nni tettwazen ɣer uqeddac-nneɣ akken ad tettwaselwet. Ma yella tugna-inek tesɛa isefka n wemkan, a ten-nesseqdac akken ad nseder tugna-nni ɣer wemkan iwatan.

• Asulɣan azadaɣ n ubenkal (i yilɣa): akken ad nizmir a k-nessekcem yiwen n yilɣa mi ara yili igilal-inek udmawan ihegga, nettesbadu asulɣan azadaɣ i ubenkal-ik (tin n yilɣa n usdukel). Wagi ur yettwaseddi ara ɣer yisem-ik neɣ tansa-ik n yimayl.
2. Acuɣer i nesseqdac isefka-agi?

• Amkan: akken a k-d-nessken talɣut n aksum ilaqen i wemkan-ik.

• Tugniwin: akken a d-nesnulfu agilal n aksum udmawan seg tuttra-inek, akken daɣen a nizmir ad d-nessken amkan-nni s tazwara akked s wudem yifen deg wussan i d-iteddun — ula i yiseqdacen nniḍen i d-yessutren agilal n unagraw yiwen.

• Asulɣan n ubenkal: akken a k-nessekcem mi ara igilal-ik ihegga.
3. Melmi ara neṭṭef isefka-agi?

• Deg webnak-ik: imukan-ik ineggura qqiment ttwaṭṭfen deg wallag alamma tekksed-ten s yiman-ik neɣ tekksed Asnas.

• Deg uqeddac-nneɣ: tugniwin i tessalyeḍ akked isefka n wemkan n tugniwin-nni ttwaṭṭafen war talast. Wagi yettwaxtar: yeṭṭaf agilal n aksum, mi ara yettwaxelq i wemkan, iwata s tazwara akked s laman — ula i yiseqdacen nniḍen.

• Asulɣan n yilɣa n usdukel: wagi yettleqqim s yiman-is yal tikkelt mi ara tesseqdaceḍ Asnas, yettwakkes s wudem awurman mi ara webnak-ik ur d-yerri ara (amedya seld tin i tkessed Asnas) neɣ seld 12 wagguren war rmes.
4. Ma yezmer tugna ad tettwaseddi ɣer-k s yiman-ik?

Ala. Ur nṭṭif ara imiḍanen n iseqdacen, ur nseddu ara wass-a isem, tansa n yimayl neɣ talɣut nniḍen yettbeggin bab-is ɣer tugna neɣ amkan. Anagraw-nneɣ yettwabna daɣen akken tansa IP n ukemmel-ik n internet ur d-tettwaru ara: ur tettwaru ara, ur tettwaṭṭaf ara akked tugna neɣ amkan. Aya yebɣa ad d-yini tugna i d-yettwazen ur tezmir ara ad tettwaseddi ɣer tansa-inek IP neɣ ɣer ukemmel n internet-ik seld tuzna-ines.
5. Beṭṭu n isefka
Ur nzenzi, ur nkri ara isefka-inek i wat waṭas. Ttwasseqdacen kan akken Asnas ad yeddu (askan n aksum akked usnulfu n ugilal-ik udmawan), mačči i tallalt n usurar neɣ n uɛarraḍ.
6. Izerfan-ik akked yifranen-ik

• Sens anekcum ɣer wemkan: di yal lawan seg yiɣewwaren n webnak-ik n Android. Asnas ihi ur yezmir ara ad d-yesken talɣut yemsasan i wemkan.\n\n• Attar n tukksa n tugna i tuzneḍ: nermes-aɣ ɣer tansa n yimayl s wadda.
7. Anermis
Ma yella ɣur-k isteqsiyen ɣef tsertit-agi n tbaḍnit neɣ amek i nesseɣti isefka, ur ttaggad ara a ɣ-d-tnermseḍ ɣer: googleplaydeveloper@vanburik.info
